name: satsuma-cli
description: Satsuma CLI — LLM context slicer for Satsuma workspaces
//files: Declares the tarball contents explicitly, which `files` lets take precedence
over every ignore file. Necessary since the tooling packages became npm
workspaces (ADR-049): npm-packlist then resolves ignore rules from the
'**/generated') silently stripped the CLI's own build output out of its
tarball. scripts/verify-pack.js is what caught it and what keeps it caught.
This list reproduces the pre-workspaces contents — narrowing it is a
separate, user-visible decision about the published artifact.

scripts.prebuild: npm run build:core && npm run build:viz-backend && node scripts/prebuild.js
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run test:typecheck
